title: Derived local Hom evaluation respects coefficient restriction
statement: Let X be a scheme, q:R→S a commutative ring map in the fixed coefficient universe, and A,D arbitrary objects of D(X_et,S). For an affine weakly contractible U of X_proet, evaluation of the sheafification and comparison pullback of the restriction map [def-weil-pbc-restriction-hom-presheaf] commutes with coefficient restriction. More precisely, compose the R-valued evaluated morphism on its right with restriction to U of the canonical comparison/coefficient isomorphism at D and the inverse slice/coefficient isomorphism. The result equals the analogous composite at A followed by restriction of scalars of the S-valued evaluated morphism. All maps are the canonical ones of [def-weil-pbc-derived-morphism-sheaf-comparison]; no finiteness or universal-arrow hypothesis is imposed.

from.place: Functoriality of local Hom evaluation under coefficient restriction, in the normalized-presheaf evaluation argument.

proof.text: Compare the coefficient mate on the localized comparison site with the global coefficient mate. Under the comparison slice adjunction both transposes are restriction of the same adjunction unit. Lift this cube of exact functors to the derived categories using derived-square pasting.

Use the cube at A and D and naturality of the local coefficient comparison to identify the two conjugated local Hom maps. Transpose the resulting identity under sheafification and comparison adjunctions. This proves the comparison square for the specified restriction Hom presheaf map.

Naturality of the pro-etale sheafification unit intertwines the restriction Hom map and conjugation by the comparison/coefficient isomorphisms. Apply injectivity of the unit at the weakly contractible affine U; its two inverse-unit equations identify the evaluated morphisms. Compose with the target coefficient isomorphism and cancel the adjacent inverse components.

theorem derivedHomEvaluation_restrictScalars
    (X : Scheme.{u}) {R S : Type (u + 1)} [CommRing R] [CommRing S] (q : R →+* S)
    (A D : DerivedCategory (Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} S)))
    (U : X.ProEt) [IsAffine U.left]
    (hw : (ProEt.topology X).IsWeaklyContractible.{u + 1} U)
    (s : ((comparisonSetUpperStar X).obj
      (derivedLocalHomSheaf X.smallEtaleTopology S A D)).obj.obj (op U)) :
    derivedHomEvaluation X R
        ((normalizationRestrict X.smallEtaleTopology q).obj A)
        ((normalizationRestrict X.smallEtaleTopology q).obj D) U hw
        (((comparisonSetUpperStar X).map
          ((presheafToSheaf X.smallEtaleTopology (Type (u + 1))).map
            (derivedRestrictionHomPresheaf X.smallEtaleTopology q A D))).hom.app
              (op U) s) ≫
      (derivedSliceRestriction (ProEt.topology X) R U).map
        ((comparisonRestrictScalarsIso X R q).hom.app D) ≫
      (sliceRestrictScalarsIso (ProEt.topology X) R q U).inv.app
        ((derivedComparison X S).obj D) =
    (derivedSliceRestriction (ProEt.topology X) R U).map
        ((comparisonRestrictScalarsIso X R q).hom.app A) ≫
      (sliceRestrictScalarsIso (ProEt.topology X) R q U).inv.app
        ((derivedComparison X S).obj A) ≫
      (normalizationRestrict ((ProEt.topology X).over U) q).map
        (derivedHomEvaluation X S A D U hw s)
